name: Resonance
description: Chronométreur marquant le tempo des assauts coordonnés pour maximiser l'impact des attaques synchronisées.

subject.archetype: Resonance — Chœur Synthétique Common class reseau

loadout.armor_outfit: Crystalline armor plates growing naturally from body vibrating at resonant frequencies with visible sound waves emanating from every surface, each facet catching and fracturing light into rainbows, organic-metal hybrid construction
loadout.arsenal: Resonance tuning fork weapon humming at visible destructive frequency with air distortion around it, harmonic shield gauntlet generating visible ring-shaped sound wave barriers, crystalline conductor baton emitting visible vibration patterns Functional combat equipment showing signs of heavy practical use and field customization

attitude.behavior: Charging assault fighter lunging into enemy ranks with aggressive momentum and lethal intent. Combat stance with weapon or tool raised and ready, eyes locked on approaching threat, body coiled like a spring ready to explode into action
attitude.emotion: Focused determination — seasoned professional locked in the moment of combat

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Violet Crystal
palette_names.role: primary_accent — resonance energy beams and crystal shards

palette_names.name: Silver Prismatic

color_and_light.lighting_setup: brushed steel utility frame, simple geometric corner markers, no ornamentation, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Eye-level medium shot capturing face and primary action clearly, shallow depth of field, motion freeze at peak of action

scenography.setting: Shattered crystalline amphitheater turned battlefield with crystal formations exploding from harmonic overload sending shards every direction, visible shockwave rings tearing through enemy positions, fragments raining from resonating cracked ceiling structures, entire environment vibrating at a frequency that makes air appear to ripple and distort
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Tension and lethal potential visible in every tensed muscle — combat readiness radiating from posture and grip on weapon, Active combat zone with explosions and engagements around the character, allies and enemies locked in fierce battle, chaos of war as backdrop, Visible concentric sound waves expanding outward shattering nearby crystal structures into cascading shards, crystal fragments flying through air catching prismatic light, air visibly rippling and bending from sonic force, ground fracturing in geometric patterns from bass, floating debris suspended in harmonic stasis field
